question: The Baisakhi festival in India marks the birth of Khalsa Panth under Guru Gobind Singh, the _____ Guru of Sikhs, in the year 1699.
solution:
The correct answer is "__**10**__**th**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A population that identifies as Sikh as well as a select group of initiated Sikhs are both referred to as **Khalsa**.
 
• The** Tenth** Guru of Sikhism, **Guru Gobind Singh**, founded the Khalsa tradition in 1699.
 
• Its founding was a significant occasion in **Sikhism's** history.
 
• Sikhs commemorate the foundation of Khalsa during the **Vaisakhi** holiday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Among the ***Dogras***, Vaisakhi is also pronounced as Baisakhi.
 
• It is customarily observed every year on the first day of the month of Vaisakh, marking both the beginning of the month of Vaisakh and the new year of the **Dogra calendar**.
 
• In Northern India specifically, it is seen as a celebration of the** spring harvest**.
 
• Beyond its significance as the harvest festival, when Sikhs hold kirtans, visit nearby **Gurdwaras**, participate in community fairs, hold nagar kirtan processions, hoist the Nishan Sahib flag, and come together to socialize and share festive foods.
 
• **Baisakhi** commemorates significant historical occurrences in Sikhism and the Indian subcontinent that took place in the Punjab region.
 
• The Khalsa order was founded on **April 13, 1699**, by Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Guru of Sikhism, and is commemorated by the major Sikh festival of Vaisakhi.
